3293-5413-5721-8345.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-5413-5721-8345.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-5413-5721-8345.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

339-413-677-8296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha, dealing 1 damage to any target
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2511-6972-7936.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it, so Dominion Saboteur will also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

851-2557-5478-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
851-2557-5478-6441-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

573-1479-7892.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Thranduil the Strategist, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3413-5231-5929.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Leyline of Transformation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

2034-4871-5220-7855--180.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, Pitiless Plunderer, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat

2034-6970-7175-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

670-1619-3175-4681-5256.easyPrerequisites: Sefris' first ability hasn't triggered this turn.
670-1619-3175-4681-5256.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in the second to last room of any dungeon.
670-1619-3175-4681-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Sefris' first ability triggers, causing you to venture into the final room of a dungeon, causing you to complete the dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Sefris and Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sefris trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into the Cave Entrace room, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into either available room.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Sefris from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sefris enters, Radiant Solar triggers, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into any available room.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.
670-1619-3175-4681-5256.notes: You may instead execute this combo by venturing into Tomb of Annihilation instead of Lost Mine of Phandelver.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5434-5555-5686-7666.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5434-5555-5686-7666.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 2.

997-2169--5.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2395-5742-6786.easyPrerequisites: You have an Island, Pirate or Vehicle card in hand.
2395-5742-6786.description:
Activate Mary Read and Anne Bonny by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and then discard an Island, Pirate or Vehicle card.
The discarded card is put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Library of Leng.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Quicksmith Genius triggers, causing you to discard an Island, Pirate or Vehicle card. The discarded card is put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Library of Leng. Afterwards, draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

628-2829-7219.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability
Repeat.

1409-1449-2557.description:
Activate Plundering Barbarian by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Barbarian enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Plundering Barbarian.
Resolve the Plundering Barbarian trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1409-1770-5421.description:
Activate Redcap Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Redcap Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Redcap Thief.
Resolve both Redcap Thief triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

6798-6837-6871-6879.description:
Cast Three Tree Mascot by paying {2}.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Three Tree Mascot.
When Three Tree Mascot dies, Haru triggers, returning Three Tree Mascot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

413-2173-5220-6537.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
When Tarpan enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2173-3845-4905-5220.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with twenty or more charge counters on it

1870-4153-5850.description:
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving all charge counters from Eternity Vessel onto Twenty-Toed Toad.
Declare Twenty-Toed Toad as an attacker. It triggers, causing you to win the game.

1563-2457-4321-5295.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token and a Food token.
Activate the Insect and Food by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
2-6747.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {0}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1491-4029-5268-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

372-745-4681.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mirrorhall Mimic.
372-745-4681.description:
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Mirrorhall Mimic's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Mirrorhall Mimic leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Mirrorhall Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Mirrorhall Mimic from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

719-2364-3767-3918.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
719-2364-3767-3918.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
719-2364-3767-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Mana Vault's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2438-3139--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
The sacrificed creature's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
The Great Henge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to draw a card.
The -1/-1 and +1/+1 counters are removed as a state-based action.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1987-2239-4276-4477.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2239-4276-4477.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Ardent Elementalist and Greenwarden of Murasa enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2239-4276-4477.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

305-1909-4486.notablePrerequisites: Llanowar Tribe does not have summoning sickness.
305-1909-4486.description:
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Llanowar Tribe.
Repeat.
305-1909-4486.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

2583-5666-5870-5874.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Sphinx of the Revelation triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

1349-2034-5239.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other nontoken creature.
Enduring Bondwarden has at least one coin counter on it.
1349-2034-5239.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Enduring Bondwarden, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Bondwarden dies, it and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Bondwarden trigger, putting all counters from it onto another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Enduring Bondwarden from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Enduring Bondwarden enters the battlefield, its backup ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature who had a coin counter placed on it, and giving it the printed ability until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature with a coin counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, it and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting all counters from it onto Enduring Bondwarden .
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

204-776-2871.notablePrerequisites:
Sorcerer Class is at least level two.
You control at least four creatures without summoning sickness.
204-776-2871.description:
Activate four creatures you control by tapping them, adding {3}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells, or to gain a Class level.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}, triggering Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities and Sorcerer Class's third ability if it is level three.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, causing Seething Anger to deal an amount of damage to each opponent equal to the number of instants and sorceries you've cast this turn.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving a creature you control +3/+0 until end of turn, and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control five or more creatures without summoning sickness, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

1165-2770-2861.notablePrerequisites: Archfiend of the Dross has no more than four oil counters on it.
1165-2770-2861.description:
Cast Heartless Act by paying {1}{B}, removing up to three oil counters from Archfiend of the Dross.
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, causing you to give control of Archfiend of the Dross to an opponent.
At the beginning of the opponent's next upkeep, Archfiend of the Dross triggers, causing the opponent to remove an oil counter from it and lose the game.

423-511-1887-3510.notablePrerequisites: Sporoloth Ancient has at least three spore counters on it.
423-511-1887-3510.description:
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saprolings enter the battlefield as Forest lands due to Life and Limb, triggering Evolution Sage, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient.
Repeat.

1642-5136.notablePrerequisites:
Quietus Spike attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill the creature with Quietus Spike attached.
Warlock Class is level three.
1642-5136.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Quietus Spike attached.
Quietus Spike triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1651-3129-4231-4732-5261.notablePrerequisites: You control another artifact or creature.
1651-3129-4231-4732-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it to cast a copy of Deadly Dispute without paying its mana cost.
As an additional cost to cast Deadly Dispute, sacrifice a creature or artifact.
Resolve Deadly Dispute, drawing two cards and creating two Food tokens, two Clue tokens, and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two untapped artifacts you control to untap Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

654-2692-2893-3470.notablePrerequisites: Fertilid has 2 or more +1/+1 counters on it.
654-2692-2893-3470.description:
Activate Fertilid, searching your library for a basic land card, putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When it enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor, Felidar Retreat and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Amulet of Vigor's trigger resolves, untapping the land.
Lotus Cobra's trigger resolves, adding {G}.
Felidar Retreat's trigger resolves, putting a +1/+1 counter on all creatures you control.
Repeat.

874-2626-4986.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2626-4986.description:
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

83-687-2034-3644.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Young Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
Young Wolf's undying ability and Mortician Beetle trigger.
Resolve the Young Wolf trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 and a vigilance counter.
Resolve the Mortician Beetle trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Mortician Beetle and removing both counters from Young Wolf.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Young Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
Young Wolf's undying ability and Mortician Beetle trigger.
Resolve the Young Wolf trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 and a vigilance counter.
Resolve the Mortician Beetle trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Young Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
Mortician Beetle triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve the Tayam ability from step 5, causing yourself to mill three cards and return Young Wolf from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
